meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 CDP 协议控制你已登录的 Chrome:打开网页、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、抓取页面快照,并从浏览器里提取登录 token。首次启动 debug Chrome 前会先征求你同意,因为这会关掉你现有 Chrome 的窗口。
howto.when: 当你需要控制 Chrome 复用已有登录态时触发,例如提到「浏览器操作」「CDP」等关键词,或要求打开网页、提取 token。需先安装 agent-browser。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 https://example.com 并等 3 秒
say.note: 会启动 debug Chrome 并打开该页面

say.text: 从当前页面 localStorage 里取 auth token
列出页面上可交互的元素
say.note: 返回可点击元素的快照

howto.what_en: Claude drives your logged-in Chrome over CDP: opens URLs, waits for load, runs JavaScript, takes snapshots, and extracts auth tokens. Before first launch it asks consent, since debug Chrome closes existing Chrome windows.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need Chrome controlled with existing login sessions — e.g. "CDP", "browser automation", or opening a page and pulling a token. Requires agent-browser installed.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com via CDP and wait 3 seconds
say_en.note: Launches debug Chrome and opens the page

say_en.text: Extract the auth token from this page's localStorage
List the interactive elements on the page
say_en.note: Returns a snapshot of clickable elements
